notes: Source 4 = Biran 1985, Eretz-Israel 18 (Hebrew), section B (Kh. Deir es-Sidd), pp. 211-213. Quotes are from the packet's English translation. Only one feature is described first-hand: the rock-cut cistern in Area A on the hilltop. Its direction is from Locus 103 (relative_to 'other'). Pl. 40:2 puts it beside the eastern face of the western enclosure wall W2. The cisterns, caves and tomb in s4f2-4 come from earlier reports quoted on p. 211 (Press; the Staff Officer survey). The author also lists caves himself. They are coded because the publication reports them at this site. The tomb's type is not stated, so cavity_with_opening is false by default. No plan position: Figs. 2-3 (pp. 211-212) have north arrows and scale bars but no grid, so the unit point (176200/135350) cannot be placed on them. The cistern is not drawn on Fig. 2. Area B (eastern slope, pillared building 120 m from the hilltop) has plaster on bedrock (p. 213), but no pool, pit or grave. The report of soundings 35 m and 50 m from Area A with 'no remains of importance' is not a statement that a feature class is absent, so no explicit_absence is recorded.
